title: First pubnet ledger whose StellarValue is SIGNED, one ledger after the last BASIC one
why: From Protocol 15 on, StellarValue.ext is SIGNED with the node ID and signature of the validator that nominated the value; the upgrade ledger 32747293 still has BASIC and this one, 32747294, is the first SIGNED. Readers that expect one arm for the whole history, or that read the signed fields as part of the close time, mis-decode the header.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger, captured for this entry.

notes: The BASIC ledger just before is protocol-15/upgrade-jump-13-to-15 (32747293). 639 transactions under Protocol 15. The lake object was written by stellar-core 23.0.1 long after the ledger closed (source.regenerated true), so its TransactionMeta is v4 with backfilled classic and fee events, not what a node emitted at the time.
